display.purpose: Page headings and open-count hero figures.

label.purpose: Field labels, status chips, nav items; uppercase, tracked.

micro.purpose: Sync status, counts, timestamps; uppercase, tracked.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Switches desktop rail to mobile bottom nav.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Min-height 44px square button for primary actions and the mobile Add FAB.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-action); color: var(--color-action-ink); padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Archivo, 'Bai Jamjuree', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.45; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined secondary action, fills plate on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Archivo, 'Bai Jamjuree', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; background: transparent; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-plate); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Danger action; hover fills danger colour and flips text to ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-danger); color: var(--color-danger); padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Archivo, 'Bai Jamjuree', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; background: transparent; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--color-danger); color: var(--color-ground); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Bottom-Rule Input
components.description: Transparent field with a 1px bottom rule; focus shifts the rule to signal.
components.css: .ds-input-field { width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule); background: transparent; padding: 10px 0; font-family: 'Bai Jamjuree', Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--color-ink); border-radius: 0; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-input-field::placeholder { color: var(--color-dim); } .ds-input-field:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--color-signal); } .ds-input-field:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Desktop Nav Rail
components.description: 220px left rail with 1px right rule; destinations are 10px uppercase tracked items with a 2px active tick in signal colour.
components.css: .ds-nav-rail { width: 220px; border-right: 1px solid var(--color-rule); background: var(--color-plate); display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px 12px 34px; font-family: Archivo, 'Bai Jamjuree', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-dim); position: relative; } .ds-nav-item::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22px; top: 50%; width: 9px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: translatey(-50%); } .ds-nav-item--active { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav-item--active::before { width: 17px; height: 2px; background: var(--color-signal); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(244,197,66,0.45); }

components.name: Mobile Bottom Nav
components.description: Four equal columns with 10px labels; active state shown by signal-colour top underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-bottom { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule); background: var(--color-ground); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 58px; padding: 8px 4px; font-family: Archivo, 'Bai Jamjuree', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-dim); } .ds-nav-item--active { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav-item--active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; top: 0; margin: auto 16px; width: 28px; height: 2px; background: var(--color-signal); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: 9px uppercase label preceded by a 4px line glyph whose form encodes status; colour confirms but never carries status alone.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; font-family: Archivo, 'Bai Jamjuree', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip-line { display: inline-block; width: 16px; height: 2px; } .ds-chip--live { color: var(--color-status-live); } .ds-chip--live .ds-chip-line { background: var(--color-status-live); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--color-status-live); } .ds-chip--hold { color: var(--color-status-hold); } .ds-chip--hold .ds-chip-line { background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-status-hold) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px); } .ds-chip--done { color: var(--color-status-done); opacity: 0.62; } .ds-chip--done .ds-chip-line { background: var(--color-status-done); opacity: 0.62; } .ds-chip--todo { color: var(--color-status-todo); } .ds-chip--todo .ds-chip-line { background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-status-todo) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px); }

components.name: Progress Line
components.description: 2px track in rule colour; filled portion in status colour bound to progress %; tabular % readout beside it.
components.css: .ds-progress { position: relative; height: 2px; width: 100%; background: var(--color-rule); } .ds-progress-fill { position: absolute; inset-y: 0; left: 0; height: 100%; background: var(--color-status-live); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--color-status-live); transition: width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }

components.name: Modal
components.description: Plate surface, square, 1px rule border, no shadow; actions right-aligned.

components.css: .ds-modal { max-height: 90vh; max-width: 704px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-plate); padding: 20px; outline: none; } .ds-modal-title { font-family: Archivo, 'Bai Jamjuree', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--color-ink); margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-modal-close { background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; font-size: inherit; } .ds-modal-body { color: var(--color-ink); font-family: 'Bai Jamjuree', Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview: A dark-first task board that reads like a calibrated instrument panel: every task row registers to one off-centre rail, and status is carried by line form before colour. Warm charcoal continuum (#14130E ground) with bone ink (#EDE6D2), sodium yellow (#F4C542) as the live/primary signal. Type is Archivo for labels and display, Bai Jamjuree for body, set at 15px with tabular numerals. 1px rules, no rounded cards, no shadows, no gradient text, uppercase tracked labels ~9-10px. Dark is the default; light mode is warm paper/charcoal opted into explicitly via ptrs.theme=light.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground (#14130E) default, light warm-paper alternative
Sodium yellow (#F4C542) signal colour for live/primary actions only
Status encoded by line form: solid = live, dashed = held, dotted = not started, doubled = urgent
1px rules; square surfaces; zero shadow vocabulary
44px minimum touch targets; Thai labels sized to fit; WCAG AA contrast
Bilingual TH/EN with parity in every label

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Status is never carried by colour alone — every status also has a distinct line form (solid / dashed / dotted / doubled). Colour is the confirmation, never the sole carrier.

rules.name: No kicker above headings
rules.body: The heading carries its own weight; delete the label and let the heading speak.

rules.name: Square-by-default
rules.body: Zero border-radius on buttons, inputs, cards, modals, and dialogs.

dos: Do encode status by line form first (solid / dashed / dotted / doubled), colour second.
Do use 1px rules and square surfaces; keep the shadow vocabulary empty.
Do keep labels ≤11px, uppercase, tracked; body at 15px with tabular numerals.
Do keep every touch target ≥44px; Thai labels must fit their containers.
Do keep TH/EN parity: every key added to th must exist in en.
donts: Don't use a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use section numbers (01/02/03) unless the sequence itself carries information.
Don't use gradient text or rounded-card stacks.
Don't carry state by colour alone.
Don't use emoji or monospace as costume; icons are drawn from one library.
